svg.title: From the car to the body shell
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 carries its occupants within a joined shell between the axles. The sills run below the door openings; the floor and tunnel connect the open passenger compartment. Follow the lower shell, front and rear bulkheads, and reinforced windscreen frame. These members share loads through their joints; the fabric hood and luggage lids are closures. Numbered parts: 1 Floor and crossmembers; 2 Left sill; 3 Right sill; 4 Centre tunnel; 5 Front bulkhead region; 6 Rear cabin wall; 7 Windscreen frame. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
